text:
✨ Designers × AI

🆕 The mockup era is over. Today’s AI tools give every designer a superpower: you can now craft your ideas, not just draw them.

The gap between “what if…?” and “look, it works!” has never been smaller, and that changed how we build features in Telegram.

Message @designers to submit your concepts.

✔️ We accept
– Working, ready-to-implement code
 complemented by
– A demo video of your feature in action

🗑 We no longer accept
– Static mockups
– Demo videos with no code behind them
– Text-only concepts

No coding background? Curiosity, attention to detail and a good prompt will take you far.

The future of design isn’t drawn – it’s built.

🚀 Let's build it together!

(An example of what is possible by our iOS designer – this is a ready to use implementation not a motion video.) 👇
author: Pavel Durov

🤝 Telegram has become the sponsor of Codeforces — the largest competitive programming platform in the world.

 ⚡CodeForces organizes over 100 coding contests every year and has 4 million contestants signed up.

🌱 Since 2010, I've supported Codeforces through the companies I started.

🆙 But this year will be special. Its founder Mike wants to bring Codeforces to the next level — and we'll be happy to help him do that 🤝

💸 In just one month, Telegram has awarded over $2,222,000 to some of the brightest minds on our planet.

🎨 This week alone we distributed $222,000 among the winners of our two latest competitions — the Design Contest and the Digital Freedom Contest.

On top of that, over the past month we awarded prizes worth more than $2 million to the winners of the 2026 International Olympiads in Informatics and AI.

We're proud to support the best! 🎁

🏳️ Gram Wallet in Telegram is ready and is now accessible to a select group of users.

🤩 We'll be gradually rolling it out to our billion+ users over the next couple of weeks.

text:
Digital Freedom Contest: Submissions

👏 We would like to thank each contestant for their input – you are all amazing! More than 1,000 links were submitted, already drawing over 67.2M views. That is the population of a large country – reached, thanks to you, with the idea of digital freedom.

🎬 We will open all submissions on contest.com in the coming days – watch for a separate announcement here. Judging is already underway; results are expected by the end of August.

❗ If you have not yet edited your video's caption on the external platform or updated your bio (on TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube or Snap) to include your @username  or t.me/username, please do so immediately. This is the only way we can verify that you are the author of the submitted video.

❗ If you have not yet edited your video's caption on the external platform or updated your bio (on TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube or Snap) to include your @username or t.me/username, please do so immediately. This is the only way we can verify that you are the author of the submitted video.

text:
ContestBot is now ready to accept submissions for the Digital Freedom Contest.

Start the bot, choose “Digital Freedom Contest”, answer the bot’s questions, then send:
– A link(s) to your video(s) on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat Spotlights or X.

Username Verification: Remember to include your Telegram @username in the caption of your video on the external platform. If you cannot edit the caption, your Telegram @username must be visible in your bio or About section on the external platform.

⚠️ Important: If you're submitting more than one video, put all links in a single message, separated by line breaks.

Note: We will automatically discard videos that gained fewer than 10,000 views by the deadline or that did not meet the username verification criteria.
